title: Matata breaks course record, Alemu sets world U20 best in New Delhi (short item in the Amsterdam report)

story.W: Wudinesh Alemu, 19, won in a world under-20 best.
story.M: Charles Matata won in a course record, leading a Kenyan sweep of the podium.

performances.name: Charles Mbatha MATATA
performances.note: Course record and personal best 58:52. Runner-up in 2023; his twin brother Alex won the 2025 race.

performances.name: Wudinesh ALEMU
performances.note: Won aged 19 in 1:06:35, a world under-20 best.
